entities.summary: Ian James McCoshen is an American professional ice hockey defenseman who is currently under contract with Barys Astana of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). McCoshen was selected by the Florida Panthers in the second round, 31st overall, of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
